text: Shinnosuke Tachibana (立花 慎之介, Tachibana Shinnosuke; born April 26, 1978) is a Japanese voice actor, singer, and narrator who is married to voice actress Ao Takahashi. He graduated from the 18th term of Aojijuku Tokyo School. Tachibana made his voice acting debut in 2003 as Kyuu in the television anime E's Otherwise. He was affiliated with Production Baobab until May 2011, after which he joined Axlone in June of the same year. On January 5, 2017, a blog reported that Tachibana had married Ao Takahashi. In 2018, he left Axlone and co-founded the BLACK SHIP agency with fellow voice actor Jun Fukuyama.
